goal: Allow node operators to inspect and toggle trace logging dynamically at runtime via the logging RPC
Make trace logging easier to configure at startup without needing both -debug and -loglevel
reviewability: Reviewing now is worthwhile as there are no known blockers or pending changes
agreement: Contested objection: three interacting flags are confusing compared to a unified loglevel model (ryanofsky)
Contested objection: impossible to set trace default while keeping specific categories at debug (ryanofsky)
Support: new flags are easier to use and RPC breaking changes are minimized (stickies-v)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because dynamic runtime control of trace logging via RPC provides clear operational value
Breaking changes to RPC return structure require deliberate review

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because it fixes the silent failure when passing -loglevel alone to enable trace logging
Trace logging is primarily an internal debugging tool rather than critical node infrastructure
